claim: Madrid totals 31 Michelin-starred restaurants in the 2026 guide, including 1 three-star and 6 two-star restaurants.
quote: Madrid has established itself as one of the great gastronomic destinations in Europe thanks to a diverse and constantly evolving culinary scene that, according to the 2026 Michelin Guide, totals 31 Michelin-starred restaurants.

claim: DiverXO's tasting menu 'Flying Pig's Cuisine' is priced at €450 per person (food only); wine pairings range from €300 to €900.
quote: The Flying Pig's Cuisine (solid menu): €450 per person. Sommelier's Pairings: three options ranging from €300–€900 per person.

claim: DiverXO releases one new reservation date each day at midnight, 90 days in advance; cancellations with ≥2 weeks' notice receive a full refund.
quote: Each day, at 00:00 hours, they enable a new date in their 2026 calendar with 90 days' notice, allowing you to book your table in advance.

claim: DiverXO is located at Calle del Padre Damián 23, 28036 Madrid; Dabiz Muñoz was elected World's Best Chef by The Best Chef Awards in 2021, 2022 and 2023.
quote: Dabiz Muñoz was elected Best Chef in the World by The Best Chef Awards in 2021, 2022, and 2023.

claim: Deessa is at Plaza de la Lealtad 5 inside the Mandarin Oriental Ritz Madrid; chef Quique Dacosta; open Wed–Sat for lunch (13:30–17:00) and dinner (20:00–00:00).

DSTAgE menus: DSTAGE (15 courses, €195), DENJOY (18 courses, €220), Dtaste (from €175); DSTAgE at Calle Regueros 8; Coque at Marqués del Riscal 11; Deessa from ~€240; Paco Roncero at Alcalá 15; Smoked Room at Paseo de la Castellana 57.
quote: DSTAgE - Menu Price: €175–€220 - Stylish loft in Salesas neighborhood; three tasting menus (Dtaste, Dstage, Denjoy) with attached DSPOT Studio for culinary research.

claim: Coque spans 1,100 m² across five sequential spaces: cocktail bar, whisky room, wine cellar, open kitchen, and dining room; run by the Sandoval family (third generation).
quote: An original and unique culinary experience, with a sensory journey through four spaces: the cocktail bar, wine cellar, kitchen and dining room.

claim: Ramón Freixa Atelier seats 10 at a U-shaped root-wood table facing the open kitchen; Origin and Vegetalia Origin menus €250 each; open Wed–Sat for dinner only (20:30–00:30).
quote: An intimate 10-seat restaurant featuring a U-shaped root wood table facing an open kitchen. Origin – €250. Vegetalia Origin (100% vegan) – €250.

claim: Ramón Freixa Atelier (Madrid) received its second Michelin star in the 2026 Michelin Guide España, one of five new two-star promotions in Spain.
quote: 5 new two-star restaurants: Aleia (Barcelona), Enigma (Barcelona), La Boscana (Lleida), Mont Bar (Barcelona), Ramon Freixa Atelier (Madrid).

claim: Smoked Room has 14 seats total (6 at the bar, 8 in the dining room); located at Paseo de la Castellana 57 in the Hyatt Regency Hesperia; specialises in charcoal, smoke and Japanese techniques.
quote: This boutique restaurant has a limited seating capacity for 14 guests, six at the bar and eight in the dining room.

claim: Smoked Room Madrid 2026 tasting menus: Kōsei no Hi €210, Matsuri €280 per person.
quote: Menú Kõsei no Hi – €210 per guest. Menú Matsuri – €280 per guest.

claim: Paco Roncero menus: Essence (Thu–Fri lunch, 15 courses) €190; Madrid, Madrid, Madrid (23 courses) €240; Gran Madrid (25 courses) €310.
quote: Grand Madrid Menu – €310. Madrid, Madrid, Madrid Menu – €240. Essence Menu (Weekday Lunch) – €190.

claim: Overview of Madrid's Michelin-starred restaurants; Coque holds 2 stars and a Green Star for sustainability.
quote: Coque is a family-run restaurant led by the Sandoval brothers... two Michelin stars plus one Green Star for sustainability.

claim: DSTAgE signature dishes include pigeon liver wrapped in beetroot and sea urchin in citric dashi; Paco Roncero at the Casino de Madrid offers views described as 'the most stunning views in Madrid'.
quote: Notable dishes include pigeon liver wrapped in beetroot, Pekin duck, and sea urchin in citric dashi. Grandiose light fixtures, checkered floors, luxury decor and the most stunning views in Madrid.

claim: Coque tasting menus range from €365 to €725; Paco Roncero is inside the NH Collection Real Casino de Madrid on Calle Alcalá with avant-garde Spanish cuisine.
quote: Coque tasting menus €365–€725. Paco Roncero at NH Collection Real Casino de Madrid, Calle Alcalá – avant-garde Spanish.
